profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Unicon, Inc.
profile.summary:
Robert Long is a Senior Software Engineer at Unicon, Inc., the leading provider of education technology consulting and digital services. Mr. Long has over 21 years of professional software design and development experience with an emphasis on learning management solutions, content-based platforms, and cloud development.

While at Unicon, Mr. Long's technical leadership has helped educational and corporate institutions execute software development and deployment projects at a variety of scales. These projects include:

the design and implementation of a SSO application targeting primary grade children for a major US publisher
the implementation of a college application system for a large state government organization
design and implementation of an open source learning management platform for several institutions
several years working closely with the Apereo Foundation (Sakai).

Mr. Long has spoken at several technical conferences. His presentations include overviews of Sakai implementation and customization, Learning Analytics, and LTI integrations. He also facilitated an internal software developer forum where developers at Unicon could present different technical topics to each other, to encourage learning across projects.

Prior to joining Unicon, Mr. Long worked in the Higher Education industry, implementing the LMS system, Sakai, as well as leading small Java-based teams for internal projects. Prior to that, Mr. Long was a seventh grade mathematics teacher and later, a mathematics and educational technology (undergraduate and graduate) professor for a Midwestern university.

Mr. Long holds a Master of Arts in Instructional Technology from Saginaw Valley State University, as well as a Bachelor of Science in Mathematics from the College of Science, Engineering, and Technology at Saginaw Valley State University. He holds a Michigan Teacher Certification certificate in Math and Physics. He  has extensive experience in the following technical areas:

Java, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, REST, PHP
JavaScript, Vue 2 & 3
Git, Subversion, Maven, Ant, Jenkins
Docker, Vagrant, VirtualBox
Sakai, Moodle, Blackboard
IMS LTI, IMS OneRoster, Learning Analytics

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
A versatile software engineer focusing on various higher education projects, from Learning Management Systems to administrative tools. I perform upgrades, implement software patches, customize code, and write database scripts.

I have 15 years of experience being the Systems Administrator for Sakai, Kuali Rice, Kaltura, and BigBlueButton. I have built / maintained / worked on many Java and Spring-based webapps.

I know many languages and technologies: Java, Apache Wicket, JSP, JSF, RSF, Velocity, PHP, JavaScript, JQuery, XML, CSS; as well as Apache Maven, Tomcat, and Ant; Eclipse is my main IDE.

positions.title: Lead Java Software Engineer / Analyst
positions.description:
I am the do-all, know-all of the Sakai project here at SVSU. I perform upgrades, implement software patches, customize the tools, and do the database and server maintenance.

I have six years of experience being the Systems Administrator for Sakai, Kuali Rice, Kaltura, and BigBlueButton on campus. I am also the head of the Java development department. I have developed and maintained many Java and PHP-based webapps at SVSU.

I know many languages and technologies: Java, Apache Wicket, JSP, JSF, RSF, Velocity, PHP, JavaScript, JQuery, XML, CSS; as well as Apache Maven, Tomcat, and Ant; Eclipse and NetBeans are my two main IDEs.

positions.title: Mathematics / Educational Technology Professor
positions.description:
Four words: I love to teach!

Academics and education are the two driving forces behind what I do. Even in my main position, I try to use my through understanding of educational technology as a backbone of development.

I have two passions: mathematics and educational technology. I love studying about them, as well as teaching them. I mainly teach undergraduate courses, but I do get the opportunity to teach a graduate course every once in a while.

positions.title: Associate Teacher - Mathematics, 7th Grade
positions.description:
I taught 7th grade mathematics in a team-teaching setting. I utilized
group and individual activities to teach mathematics concepts. I aligned student achievement with national and state benchmarks.

projects.title: Sakai
projects.description:
A robust system supporting over 4 million educational users to enhance collaborative teaching, learning and research.

Sakai represents the values and requirements of the community of educators that have contributed to the software:

Academic collaboration
Research collaboration
Portfolios
Enterprise reliability
Open pedagogy
Open standards
